name: rosetta-diversity-prediction-theorem
code:
use default

square(value: double) -> double => value * value

mean(values: double[]) -> double =>
    (values |> reduce(0.0D, (total, v) => total + v)) /
    cast(values.count)

report(truth: double, estimates: double[]) is
    let collective = mean(estimates)

    let average_error =
        mean(estimates |> map(e => square(e - truth)) |> collect_array())

    let collective_error = square(collective - truth)

    let diversity =
        mean(estimates |> map(e => square(e - collective))
                       |> collect_array())

    let shown = estimates |> map(e => "{e:G}") |> join(" ")

    write_line("true value {truth:G}, estimates {shown}")
    write_line("  average individual error {average_error:F3}")
    write_line("  collective error         {collective_error:F3}")
    write_line("  prediction diversity     {diversity:F3}")
    write_line("")
si

square(value: double) -> double => value * value

mean(values: double[]) -> double =>
    (values |> reduce(0.0D, (total, v) => total + v)) /
    cast(values.count)

report(truth: double, estimates: double[]) is
    let collective = mean(estimates)

    let average_error =
        mean(estimates |> map(e => square(e - truth)) |> collect_array())

    let collective_error = square(collective - truth)

    let diversity =
        mean(estimates |> map(e => square(e - collective))
                       |> collect_array())

    let shown = estimates |> map(e => "{e:G}") |> join(" ")

    write_line("true value {truth:G}, estimates {shown}")
    write_line("  average individual error {average_error:F3}")
    write_line("  collective error         {collective_error:F3}")
    write_line("  prediction diversity     {diversity:F3}")
